next.reason: 1985: 'NEXT GROUP IS { integer-1 | PLUS integer-2 | NEXT PAGE }'; 2023: 'NEXT GROUP IS { integer-1 | {PLUS|+} integer-2 | NEXT PAGE [ WITH RESET ] }'. Same three alternatives, but 2023 adds + as a synonym for PLUS and an optional WITH RESET after NEXT PAGE, so it accepts programs the 1985 format refuses.
